## AssetCache  (type-only)
interface AssetCache<T = unknown> {
    acquire<V extends T>(key: string, load: () => Promise<V>, size: (value: V) => number): Promise<V>;
    release(key: string): void;
    pin(key: string): void;
    unpin(key: string): void;
    has(key: string): boolean;
    refs(key: string): number;
    dispose(key: string): boolean;
    readonly stats: AssetCacheStats;
}

## AssetCacheOptions  (type-only)
interface AssetCacheOptions<T> {
    budgetBytes: number;
    onEvict?: (key: string, value: T) => void;
}

## AssetCacheStats  (type-only)
interface AssetCacheStats {
    bytes: number;
    entries: number;
    hits: number;
    misses: number;
    evictions: number;
}

## AssetKind  (type-only)
type AssetKind = ManifestEntry['kind'];

## AssetOf  (type-only)
type AssetOf<E extends ManifestEntry> = E extends TextureEntry ? Texture : E extends TextureArrayEntry ? Texture : E extends GltfEntry ? GltfScene : E extends AudioEntry ? AudioBuffer : E extends JsonEntry ? unknown : E extends TextEntry ? string : E extends BytesEntry ? ArrayBuffer : E extends ImageEntry ? ImageBitmap : E extends AtlasEntry<infer N> ? AtlasAsset<N> : never;

## AssetReader  (type-only)
type AssetReader = (uri: string) => Promise<ReadResult>;

## Bundle  (type-only)
interface Bundle<M extends Manifest> {
    readonly manifest: M;
    readonly progress: BundleProgress;
    readonly errors: BundleError[];
    readonly cancelled: boolean;
    load(keys?: (keyof M & string)[]): Promise<void>;
    get<K extends keyof M & string>(key: K): AssetOf<M[K]>;
    has(key: keyof M & string): boolean;
    on<K extends keyof BundleEvents>(type: K, fn: (payload: BundleEvents[K]) => void): () => void;
    cancel(): void;
    release(key?: keyof M & string): void;
    dispose(): void;
}

## GLTF_LIT_WGSL
const GLTF_LIT_WGSL = "\n@group(1) @binding(1) var baseSampler: sampler;\n@group(1) @binding(2) var baseTex: texture_2d<f32>;\n\n@fragment fn fs_main(in: VSOut) -> FragOut {\n  let c = textureSample(baseTex, baseSampler, in.uv) * in.color;\n  if (in.params.x > 0.0 && c.a < in.params.x) { discard; }\n  let n = normalize(in.normal);\n  let sky = 0.5 + 0.5 * n.y;\n  var o: FragOut;\n  o.color = vec4f(c.rgb * (engine_lambert(n, in.worldPos) + 0.12 * sky), c.a);\n  o.emissive = vec4f(0.0);\n  return o;\n}\n";

## GltfScene
class GltfScene {
    readonly meshes: Mesh[];
    readonly textures: Texture[];
    readonly materials: Material[];
    readonly materialNames: (string | null)[];
    readonly palette: SkinPalette | null;
    readonly transforms: Transform[];
    readonly nodes: GltfSceneNode[];
    readonly bounds: {
        center: [number, number, number];
        radius: number;
    };
    readonly skins: readonly GltfSkin[];
    readonly animations: readonly GltfAnimation[];
    readonly morphs: readonly GltfMorph[];
    readonly lights: GltfSceneLights;
    readonly cameras: readonly GltfCamera[];
    readonly variants: readonly string[];
    constructor(doc: GltfDocument, ownsMaterials: boolean, palette?: SkinPalette | null);
    get variant(): string | null;
    setVariant(name: string | null): this;
    bindVariants(resolve: ((index: number | null) => Material) | null, litParams: boolean, draws: VariantDraw[]): void;
    morph(nodeIndex: number): GltfMorph | null;
    addMorph(morph: GltfMorph, entries: MorphEntry[]): void;
    draw(frame: Frame): void;
    destroy(): void;
}

    material?: Material;
    lit?: GltfLitMode;
    palette?: SkinPalette;
    label?: string;
    mips?: boolean;
    decodeImage?: (bytes: Uint8Array, mimeType: string | null) => Promise<GltfImageSource>;
    lightScale?: number;
}

## Manifest  (type-only)
type Manifest = Record<string, ManifestEntry>;

## ManifestEntry  (type-only)
type ManifestEntry = TextureEntry | TextureArrayEntry | GltfEntry | AudioEntry | JsonEntry | TextEntry | BytesEntry | ImageEntry | AtlasEntry;

## MeshoptError
class MeshoptError extends Error {
    readonly name = "MeshoptError";
}

## MeshoptFilter  (type-only)
type MeshoptFilter = 'NONE' | 'OCTAHEDRAL' | 'QUATERNION' | 'EXPONENTIAL';

## MeshoptMode  (type-only)
type MeshoptMode = 'ATTRIBUTES' | 'TRIANGLES' | 'INDICES';

## ReadResult  (type-only)
type ReadResult = ArrayBuffer | Blob | ImageBitmap | {
    data: ArrayBuffer | Blob | ImageBitmap;
    total?: number;
};

## SKINNED_JOINTS_OFFSET
@deprecated
const SKINNED_JOINTS_OFFSET = 48;

## SKINNED_VERTEX_STRIDE
@deprecated
const SKINNED_VERTEX_STRIDE: number;

## SKINNED_WEIGHTS_OFFSET
@deprecated
const SKINNED_WEIGHTS_OFFSET = 52;

## SkinnedVertices  (type-only)
interface SkinnedVertices {
    vertices: ArrayBuffer;
    layout: 'skinned';
}

## TextEntry  (type-only)
interface TextEntry {
    kind: 'text';
    uri: string;
}

## TextureArrayEntry  (type-only)
interface TextureArrayEntry {
    kind: 'texture-array';
    uris: string[];
    options?: LoadTextureArrayOptions;
}

## TextureEntry  (type-only)
interface TextureEntry {
    kind: 'texture';
    uri: string;
    options?: LoadTextureOptions;
}

## TextureRef  (type-only)
interface TextureRef {
    index: number;
    texCoord: number;
    transform: GltfTextureTransform | null;
}

## Vec3  (type-only)
type Vec3 = [number, number, number];

## Vec4  (type-only)
type Vec4 = [number, number, number, number];

## applyGltfCamera
function applyGltfCamera(camera: Camera, c: GltfCamera, aspect: number): Camera;

## composeTrs
function composeTrs(t: Vec3, q: Vec4, s: Vec3, out: Float32Array): void;

};
